blurb.en: Multi-character VCF on a discrete transistor OTA core. Switchable 12/24 dB slope and a solid-bass mode.
blurb.fi: Monikäyttöinen VCF diskreetillä transistori-OTA-ytimellä. Vaihdettava 12/24 dB jyrkkyys ja tukeva bassotila.
blurb.sv: Mångsidigt VCF med diskret transistor-OTA-kärna. Växlingsbar branthet på 12/24 dB och ett stadigt basläge.

reviews.title: River Creative Technology Crux and Nucleus Eurorack Modules

pull.q: While there are technically superior alternatives, a discrete circuit excels in providing a warmer and more lively sound.

quotes.t: I wanted to try something a little different and see if I could come up with something that sounds unique and musical in its own right, rather than being a retake on proven circuits from the past.
Pleasantly saturating input stage and resonance with higher levels.
